Text: OCR of the page images with line coordinates (gemini-3-flash-preview; gemini-3.7-flash where it failed; damaged pages transcribed again). The review rounds concerned the structure, the line numbers and the placement of the apparatus, not the wording. The Latin text was neither collated nor re-read by a model; it is the OCR, with damaged pages transcribed again. Spelling follows the printed page. Later checks are listed in the revision description. Headings inside a div (sub-headings, closing formulas, labels of tables) are ab[@type='head']. The words of diagrams and tables are not body text: each diagram or table is given once as figure after the last body line printed before it (labels, trees and tables transcribed; pure geometry described in figDesc); where the edition counts the rows of a diagram or table as lines, those line numbers are not used by any lb. Evident misprints of the printed edition, identified on the page image, are kept and given with the correct form as choice/sic/corr; mere variants of spelling or accentuation are left as printed. Misprinted numbers in milestones (Bekker references, old-edition page, folio, column and line numbers), which cannot carry choice/sic/corr, are given with the corrected value where the sequence of the numbers determines it. Line breaks: one lb per printed line; @n is the line count of the CAG page (headings included), resynchronised on the printed marginal numbers of the left margin; lines the edition does not count carry lb without @n. Words hyphenated across lines are joined and the lb is placed at the following word boundary. pb/@facs points to the image of the page in the Internet Archive item named in the source description (BookReader page image; for pages supplied from another copy, that copy). Critical-apparatus entries are attached to the line(s) they cite as note[@type='apparatus'] with @target on the lb (line level; the lemma words of an entry are not linked); entries that cannot be resolved remain as note[@type='footnote'] at the page end. References in the margins to older editions or manuscripts are milestone[@type='alt-edition'] with @unit and @ed (the edition identified from the preface of the volume); CAG's repetition of the current old-edition page or folio beside the first line of each page is not encoded. Bekker references printed before lemmata are milestone[@unit='bekker']. Marginal digits fused into the text by OCR have been removed.
